summary: Tested Branding & Design settings for events. All 19 backend API tests pass (100%). Frontend UI verified working - Settings tab navigation, Branding & Design page loads with default values (primary: #0f172b, secondary: #3b82f6, font: inter), Live Preview section displays current branding, color pickers allow hex input, Font Family dropdown has all 6 options (Inter, Roboto, Poppins, Open Sans, Lato, Montserrat), Save Changes persists data, Reset Defaults restores default values.
critical_code_review_comments: Color picker validation shows console warnings during typing partial hex codes - this is expected browser behavior for input[type=color] sync
Backend properly validates hex color format (#rrggbb) and font family values
Reset endpoint correctly clears logo URLs and restores default colors/font
seed_data_creation: Event 1 branding data auto-created via GET endpoint
context_for_next_testing_agent: Branding & Design settings fully working.
